//: Codex telemetry wiring for the dev kit. The installer copies this to ~/.codex/hooks.json with {{DEVKIT_ROOT}} replaced by the absolute kit path. NOTE: Codex caps SessionEnd at ~1s, too short for a network send, so we only wire Stop (writes a cheap per-session marker) + SessionStart (flushes stale markers from prior sessions). Delivery therefore happens on the next Codex session start after the outbox stale window (10 min) — the same opt-in, anonymous, one-event-per-session behavior as the Claude path. Hooks must be trusted once via `/hooks` before Codex runs them.
